rules.requirement: 进口化妆品用于销售，须先由进口方向泰国 FDA 通报并取得通报回执；回执有效期 3 年。

excerpts.text: Any individual wishing to manufacture, import for sale, or subcontract for the manufacture and sale of cosmetics must file a notification and only after the issuing of a notification receipt may the individual undertake the manufacture or import of cosmetics.
excerpts.source_title: Thai FDA – Cosmetics Act B.E. 2558 (2015), English translation

excerpts.text: The notification receipt shall remain valid for a period of three years as from the date of issue.

rules.title: 内置/配套锂电池：UN38.3 测试与测试摘要（运输必备）
